title: Give every AI agent its own identity

slides.hook: Your MCP server trusts every agent the same
slides.subtitle: Four controls that turn anonymous tool calls into accountable actions

slides.statement: An agent holding a shared API key is an anonymous insider with standing access to every tool it can reach.
slides.note: The fix is an identity per agent, scoped per tool and checked on every call.

slides.title: Signs your agents share one identity
items: Audit logs name the integration, never the agent
Revoking one agent rotates everyone's key
Tool scopes were granted once and never reviewed
Nobody knows which human approved a call

slides.title: Give every agent its own identity

steps.title: Register a workload identity
steps.detail: One per agent, owned by a team

slides.title: Where to start: autonomy against access
One call, three checks
slides.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Agent] -->|token exchange| G[Gateway]
  G -->|actor and scope| P{Policy decision}
  P -->|allow| T[MCP tool]
  P -->|deny| L[Audit log]
  T --> L
slides.alt: Flow chart: the agent exchanges its token at the gateway, a policy decision allows or denies the call, allowed calls reach the MCP tool, and both outcomes are written to the audit log.
slides.caption: Identity at the gateway, authorization at the policy point, evidence in the log.

slides.label: places to check an agent's identity on every call
slides.context: The gateway that issues the token, the policy point that scopes it, and the tool that acts on it.

slides.title: Defense in depth for tool calls

cells.label: Identity
cells.text: A distinct, revocable principal per agent

slides.quote: Treat every tool call as a privileged access request, because that is exactly what it is.

slides.statement: Least privilege still works for agents. It just has to be decided per call instead of per project.
slides.note: Standing access is the risk; short-lived, scoped tokens are the control.

slides.title: Do this Monday
items: List every agent and the key it uses
Give each agent its own workload identity
Log the requesting user on every call
Scope one high-access agent per tool
